model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria when assessing a system or interface, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the participant count shown on the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 6. The bars are color-coded and sorted in descending order by participant count: “Relevant FCs” (dark purple) was selected by 6 participants, “FC Summary” (dark blue) by 5, “Relevance Explanation” (teal) and “Clarity and Simplicity” (green-teal) each by 3, “Overall Summary” (light green) by 2, and both “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” (light lime green) by 1 participant each. The chart visually emphasizes the most frequently chosen criteria through bar length and color intensity, with no additional annotations or error bars present.
